corrections: (c) 逐字声明处数:「两处 causation cannot be proven」→ 实为至少三处逐字 + 两处同义变体,共五处。逐字三处:①摘要 Conclusions「…though causation cannot be proven and more years of data will provide a more complete picture.」②引言第3段「(although causation cannot be proven, given the impossibility of experimental research on cultural change)」③正文结论末句「The rapid spread of smartphones and social media in the years since 2012 may be connected to this rise in loneliness, though causation cannot be proven.」变体两处:④方法前言「Although such analyses cannot prove causation, they can test whether cultural indicators can be ruled in or out.」⑤讨论「Although these analyses cannot prove causation, they demonstrate that loneliness grew among adolescents around the world in tandem with widespread smartphone and internet use.」证据:论文 CC BY 全文 PDF(district8sonpm.org 镜像)第2、4、11、12页 + PubMed 摘要 PMID 34294429。原论断低估了论文的自我限定强度,方向无误。

(b) 分母与构念口径:「n=1,049,784、15-16岁、全球高孤独 17.12%→30.86%」→ 数字全部逐字属实,但三处口径需限定。①n=1,049,784 是 2000/2003/2012/2015/2018 五轮、37国的合计样本(531,370 女 / 518,414 男,51% 女),不是 2012→2018 两轮的样本;Table 2 分轮 n 为 2012=198,992、2018=264,506。②论文原话是「These items were asked in at least 4 of the 5 administrations」,即并非每国每轮都有数据(Table 1/2 中 Iceland、Hungary 的 2012 格为破折号)。③17.12%/30.86% 的正式标签是「Percent high in school loneliness」,定义为 1–4 量表上得分 ≥2.22(由 mixtools 双成分混合模型推导的切点),且是「按各国人口规模加权」的37国加权平均(Table 2 注1、注4;方法称 weighted by country population in 2018),不是原始受访者百分比,也不是任何临床意义上的患病率。④「nearly twice」的精确值是 +80.26% 相对增幅(Table 2 worldwide % diff 2012–2018),30.86/17.12=1.80。

(f) 分母与模型层级:「smartphone Std.b=.29 / internet .38 / 失业 −.18 / GDP·GINI·生育率不显著」→ 系数值逐字全对(Table 3 additive models),但分母不是 37 国。①手机与上网模型 n=83 个「国-年」数据点、k=31 国(论文注:「Data on smartphone access and internet use are only available 2012–2018」,且测量仅在 37 国中的 31 国采集);失业/GDP/生育率模型 n=179、k=37;收入不平等 n=123、k=26(GINI 仅26国可得)。②全部为生态学(国家层面)关联,论文明言「we take an ecological approach」,非个体层面剂量-反应。③「GINI 不显著」仅对 additive 主效应成立;interaction model 中 GINI×year 交互项显著(b=.0003, t=2.31, p<.05)。④论文正文与 Table 4 数字自相矛盾:正文写 comprehensive model 中「only smartphone access (Std. b = .26) and year (Std. b = 0.29)」,而 Table 4 model A 列的是 smartphone .29 / year .27(两数疑似互换);Table 4 的 n=61, k=23,分母进一步缩小。

(e) 名单勘误与「韩国唯一未上升」的适用范围:「13国未过 configural invariance(含日韩法);韩国唯一未上升」→ 两点均属实但需补正。①13国计数与日、韩、法在列均逐字属实(原文:「The remaining 13 countries did not pass configural invariance (Brazil, Bulgaria, France, Hong Kong, Iceland, Indonesia, Japan, Luxembourg, Peru, Mexico, Russia, South Korea, and Thailand)」),但该名单存在published error:Iceland 同时出现在「12国完全不变性」名单和这份13国名单中,而 Table 1 中确实存在的 Ireland 在三份名单里全部缺席;12+12+13=37 与国家数吻合,故第三份名单的 Iceland 应为 Ireland 之误。此误不影响13这个计数,也不影响日/韩/法在列。②「韩国唯一未上升」只在连续均值指标上成立(Table 1: 韩国 d(2012–2018)=−.10, 95%CI −.14~−.05;原文「school loneliness declined in South Korea, the only country of the 37 to not increase in loneliness」)。在同一篇论文的二分「% high」指标上,韩国 2012=18.79% → 2018=20.48%,相对增幅 +8.99%,即上升。③韩国本身属于未过 configural invariance 的13国之一,其趋势估计是全样本中可比性最弱的一档,不宜当作强反例或强正例使用。

corrections: (c) 逐字声明数量低估:修正前「两处 causation cannot be proven」→ 修正后「精确短语 "causation cannot be proven" 共出现三处:摘要 Conclusions("though causation cannot be proven and more years of data will provide a more complete picture")、引言("although causation cannot be proven, given the impossibility of experimental research on cultural change")、结论末句("though causation cannot be proven.");另有两处变体 "cannot prove causation"(方法论段 "Although such analyses cannot prove causation, they can test whether cultural indicators can be ruled in or out";讨论段 "Although these analyses cannot prove causation, they demonstrate that…")。合计五处因果保留声明,而非两处。」

(b) 百分比数值正确但口径需限定:修正前「全球高孤独 17.12%(2012)→30.86%(2018)」→ 修正后「数字逐字无误(Table 2 Worldwide average 行:2000=16.15%、2003=13.21%、2012=17.12%、2015=24.03%、2018=30.86%、% diff 2000–2018=91.05%、% diff 2012–2018=80.26%),但须限定三点:①「高孤独」= 1–4 量表上得分 ≥2.22,该切点由 2 成分正态混合模型(mixtools)估出,非临床阈值;②该「全球平均」按各国人口规模加权,不是把百万受访者直接汇总的原始比例;③论文明说该二分变量只用于描述统计 —— 原文 "We present only descriptive statistics for this dichotomous variable; all other analyses and models are based on the continuous measure of loneliness." 故 17.12→30.86 不进入任何模型。」

论文对「测量不变性会不会制造假上升」这一最直接的反驳做了正面回应,且方向对自己不利地稳健:"The loneliness increase averaged d = 0.43 from 2012 to 2018 among countries showing full measurement invariance on the loneliness scale, d = 0.31 among countries with configural and metric invariance, and d = 0.32 among countries without configural measurement invariance over time (weighted by population size). Thus, the countries with the most stable measurement had the largest increase in loneliness." 即测量最稳的国家涨幅最大,削弱了「上升系测量漂移所致」的替代解释。

corrections: (a) 引语逐字成立,但计数不成立。摘要原文确为 "School loneliness increased 2012–2018 in 36 out of 37 countries."(正文 §3.3 作 "Adolescent loneliness increased after 2012 in 36 of 37 countries")。但 Table 1/Table 2 显示冰岛(Iceland)与匈牙利(Hungary)2012 年格为破折号,表注 5 明言 "Dashes indicate that the survey or measure was not administered in that country in that year",两国的 d(2012–2018) 也是 "–"。修正前:36/37 国 2012–2018 上升;修正后:有 2012 数据的只有 35 国,其中 34 国上升、1 国(韩国)下降。"36 out of 37" 与自家表格算不平——分母含两个无 2012 基线的国家。方法节亦自承入选规则只是 "These items were asked in at least 4 of the 5 administrations"。

(b) 17.12%→30.86% 数字逐字正确(Table 2 "Worldwide average" 行),但口径需三处限定。修正前:全球高孤独 17.12%→30.86%;修正后:(i) 该"全球"是按各国人口加权的平均(Table 2 注 4: "Region and worldwide averages are weighted by the population size of each country"),非各国等权均值;(ii) "高孤独"= 1–4 分量表上 ≥2.22,是作者用 2-component 正态混合模型(mixtools)自行估出的切点,非临床阈值,且论文自限 "We present only descriptive statistics for this dichotomous variable; all other analyses and models are based on the continuous measure of loneliness";(iii) 相对增幅 80.26%,摘要措辞是 "nearly twice as many",不是"翻倍"。

(b) 年龄口径需补限定。修正前:15-16 岁;修正后:"nationally representative samples of 15- and 16-year-olds **enrolled in school**",且 "Most students (67%) were 15 years old, with the rest 16 years old"——是在校生、且以 15 岁为主,失学/辍学青少年不在框内。

(c) 计数低估。修正前:两处 "causation cannot be proven" 类声明;修正后:共五处,其中三处为完全逐字的 "causation cannot be proven":(1) 摘要 Conclusions "…though causation cannot be proven and more years of data will provide a more complete picture.";(2) 引言 "(although causation cannot be proven, given the impossibility of experimental research on cultural change)";(3) 全文最后一句 "…may be connected to this rise in loneliness, though causation cannot be proven." 另有两处变体:"Although such analyses cannot prove causation, they can test whether cultural indicators can be ruled in or out." 与 "Although these analyses cannot prove causation, they demonstrate that loneliness grew among adolescents around the world…"

(e) "韩国唯一未上升"依赖于指标选择,须标明。修正前:韩国是唯一未上升国家;修正后:仅在**连续均值**口径上成立——正文逐字 "school loneliness declined in South Korea, the only country of the 37 to not increase in loneliness",Table 1 韩国 1.87(2012)→1.82(2018),d = −.10 (−.14, −.05)。但在同文 Table 2 的**二分"高孤独占比"**口径上,韩国由 18.79% 升到 20.48%(% diff = +8.99%),即上升。两张表相互抵触,"唯一未上升"不是跨指标稳健的结论。

(f) 系数逐字正确但层级与稳健性须限定。修正前:smartphone Std.b=.29 / internet .38 / 失业率 −.18;修正后:三者均为 Table 3 **加法模型(additive model)** 的国家—年度层面(ecological / group-level)关联,非个体层面效应,且样本极小:smartphone 与 internet 模型 n = 83 个国家-年观测、k = 31 国(该两变量仅 2012/2015/2018 且仅 31/37 国有);失业率/GDP/生育率 n = 179, k = 37;GINI n = 123, k = 26。失业率的负向关联**不稳健**:交互模型中 Std. b = −.05, t = −0.50,不显著;两个综合模型里失业率均掉出,只剩 smartphone(Std. b = .26)与 year(Std. b = 0.29),或只剩 internet use(Std. b = .40)。
(f) "smartphone access" 构念须修正。修正前:智能手机拥有/使用;修正后:题目是家庭可及性单题 —— "Which of these is available for you to use at home? … Cell phone with Internet access",计入回答 "yes, and I use it" 的百分比;既非个人持有率,也非使用时长。

摘要逐字(经 Semantic Scholar API 独立镜像与 PDF 双核):"School loneliness increased 2012-2018 in 36 out of 37 countries. Worldwide, nearly twice as many adolescents in 2018 (vs. 2012) had elevated levels of school loneliness. … In multi-level modeling analyses, school loneliness was high when smartphone access and internet use were high. In contrast, higher unemployment rates predicted lower school loneliness. Income inequality, GDP, and total fertility rate (family size) were not significantly related to school loneliness when matched by year." https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.1016/j.adolescence.2021.06.006

Table 2 "Worldwide average" 行逐格:2000=16.15%,2003=13.21%,2012=17.12%,2015=24.03%,2018=30.86%,% diff 2000–2018 = 91.05%,% diff 2012–2018 = 80.26%。表注 2:"High loneliness is defined as a score of 2.22 or above on the 1–4 scale." 表注 4:人口加权。

构念(claim d)完全成立,六题逐字:"I feel like an outsider (or left out of things) at school," "I make friends easily at school"(反向),"I feel like I belong at school"(反向),"I feel awkward and out of place in my school," "Other students seem to like me"(反向),"I feel lonely at school." 四点量表 1–4,Cronbach alpha = .82。论文自认逐字:"Although the school loneliness measure does not directly assess depressive symptoms, it is positively correlated with a measure of negative affect including emotions linked to depression (such as feeling miserable and sad)…" 效度相关(仅 2018、国内计算):负性情绪 r = .18~.46,正性情绪 r = −.29~−.47,生活满意度 r = −.20~−.45。补充:六题中仅一题字面含 "lonely",三题为反向计分的归属/被接纳题,构念更接近 school belonging。

不变性(claim e)逐字成立:"The remaining 13 countries did not pass configural invariance (Brazil, Bulgaria, France, Hong Kong, Iceland, Indonesia, Japan, Luxembourg, Peru, Mexico, Russia, South Korea, and Thailand)." 含日本、韩国、法国,计 13 国,无误。另 12 国全不变、12 国 configural+metric 不含 scalar。判定标准:CFI > 0.90 定 configural,Delta CFI ≤ 0.02 定 metric/scalar。

一手内部错误(独立发现,非论断错误):Iceland 同时出现在 12 国"full measurement invariance"名单与 13 国"did not pass configural invariance"名单中,而 Ireland 三个名单都未出现。12+12+13=37 只因冰岛被重复计数;其中一处 "Iceland" 几乎肯定应为 "Ireland"(冰岛无 2012 数据却被列入全不变组,亦相互矛盾)。引用该 13 国名单时宜加注。

多层模型系数逐字核对(Table 3,additive model):Smartphone access b=.0037***, t=3.72, Std. b=.29, CI[.0017,.0055](n=83, k=31);Internet use b=.0753**, t=2.97, Std. b=.38, CI[.0308,.1287](n=83, k=31);Unemployment b=−.0057*, t=−2.54, Std. b=−.18, CI[−.0101,−.0008](n=179, k=37);Income inequality(GINI, n=123, k=26)、GDP(n=179, k=37)、Total fertility rate(n=179, k=37)均不显著。表注:"n's represent the total number of datapoints by k countries over time";"Data on smartphone access and internet use are only available 2012–2018."

综合模型逐字:"In a model including smartphone access, unemployment, income inequality, GDP, total fertility rate, and year, only smartphone access (Std. b = .26) and year (Std. b = 0.29) were significant predictors of school loneliness. In a model including internet use, unemployment, GDP, income inequality, total fertility rate, and year, only internet use (Std. b = .40) was a significant predictor." 失业率在两个综合模型中均不显著。
